dedupe_keys.name: breitbandatlas gigabit grundbuch fixed and mobile broadband coverage of germany

description: The Breitbandatlas is Germany's central information medium on current broadband supply, run by the Federal Network Agency (Bundesnetzagentur) through its central information office as part of the Gigabit-Grundbuch programme. It shows fixed broadband availability by technology (FTTH, FTTB, FTTC, HFC and others) and speed class for private households, businesses and traffic routes, and mobile coverage by generation (2G, 4G, 5G and 5G standalone) and operator, mapped on standard 100 by 100 metre grid cells. The download page offers mobile network statistics by operator, coverage deficit areas as a table and as GeoPackage, statistics down to municipality level, raw mobile data as CSV (about 101 MB), mobile coverage by technology as GeoPackage (about 1.3 GB), a broadband availability workbook and fixed-network grid cell data (a ZIP of about 279 MB). Coverage: all of Germany; fixed data as of 31 December 2025 and mobile data of June 2026 at the time of reading, updated regularly. Format and access: web map, PDF exports and downloads in XLSX, CSV and GeoPackage, free for commercial and non-commercial use with attribution 'Breitbandatlas | Gigabit-Grundbuch'. Caveats: availability is reported by operators; grid cells mask variation inside them; mobile coverage is modelled. Simulation uses: broadband and mobile service areas for hazard exposure, resilience and equity studies, and planning of network upgrades. Related records: Arcep Mon Réseau Mobile and FCC Form 477 are counterparts.
